title: pre-push refuses a done move while the card's own code commit is red, in flight or unjudged
description: Fabio, 2026-09-19, after MPI-818: make the close-out CI check mechanical. MPI-811 and MPI-781 both left the board as shipped while their own commits were red in CI. The gate must blame correctly: it blocks only the card whose code commit brought NEW failing specs (or has no verdict yet), never a close that merely happens during someone else's red - otherwise every agent is blocked again.
